description: This file contains the implementation of the ActivationMigrationManager class and related interfaces for migrating grain activations between silos in Orleans. It manages migration requests, processes cluster membership updates, and handles communication with target silos.

classes.name: ActivationMigrationManager
classes.description: Manages the migration of grain activations between silos, handling migration requests, cluster membership updates, and communication with target silos.

classes.name: GrainMigrationPackage
classes.description: Represents a package containing information about a grain migration, including grain ID and migration context.

classes.name: MigrationWorkItem
classes.description: Represents a unit of work for migrating a grain, supporting async completion and pooling.

methods.name: AcceptMigratingGrains
methods.description: Processes incoming migration packages to prepare activations for migration.

methods.name: MigrateAsync
methods.description: Initiates migration of a specific grain to a target silo.

methods.name: ProcessMembershipUpdates
methods.description: Continuously processes cluster membership updates to manage migration workers accordingly.

methods.name: PumpMigrationQueue
methods.description: Handles the migration work queue for a specific target silo, batching and sending migration requests.

methods.name: GetOrCreateWorker
methods.description: Gets or creates a migration worker channel and task for a target silo.

methods.name: RemoveWorker
methods.description: Removes and cleans up a migration worker for a specific silo.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the migration manager, completing all migration workers.
